item.title: Iranian Missiles Evade Israel’s Formidable Defenses, Hitting 2 Cities
item.summary: Iranian missiles struck Dimona and Arad in southern Israel, injuring dozens of people. Iran’s state media said the attack on Dimona was aimed at Israel’s nuclear facilities, which U.N. officials said were not hit.

item.title: Zelensky Sends Negotiators to the U.S., Hoping to Revive Peace Talks
item.summary: The Ukrainian president has said he has a “very bad feeling” about the effects of the Iran conflict on Ukraine’s own war.

item.title: Iranian Sailors, Including Survivors of Torpedoed Ship, Remain in Limbo
item.summary: Sri Lanka has kept more than 250 sailors in protective custody since the early days of the war. Iran wants them back, but Sri Lanka is unsure what to do with them.

item.title: A Public Holiday Every Week? Sri Lankans Bemoan the Enforced Day Off.
item.summary: The island’s government, rationing fuel amid shortages from the Iran war, surprised residents by imposing an unusual four-day week.

item.title: On a Holiday of Renewal, Iranians Are Mourning and Fearful
item.summary: As they start a new year, Iranians are reckoning with bombardment, repression and economic misery. Still, many are holding fast to ancient traditions.

item.title: A Brussels Community Moves on From Terrorist Attacks, but New Challenges Emerge
item.summary: Molenbeek was branded a hotbed of radicalization after the Paris and Brussels terrorist attacks of a decade ago. It is trying to reinvent itself amid new challenges.

item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Saturday
item.summary: An Iranian missile wounded dozens in Dimona, a city believed to house Israel’s nuclear weapons program, as Iran showed no signs of backing down.

item.title: Iranian missile strikes Israeli city near main nuclear research facility.
No Pills or Needles, Just Paper: How Deadly Drugs Are Changing
item.summary: Lab-made drugs soaked into the pages of letters, books and even legal documents are being smuggled behind bars, killing inmates and frustrating investigators.

item.title: ​At Least 14 Killed in South Korean Factory Fire
item.summary: Survivors jumped from windows to escape the blaze, the deadliest at a factory in South Korea in two years. Four people are still missing.
